rule.holds: a correction holds size when every pooled and every reading verdict holds
rule.indicative: fewer than 999 permutations in any run, or a missing run
rule.pooled: per cohort table x statistic over the table's Type I readings: rate <= alpha + pooled_k*sqrt(alpha(1-alpha)/R_pooled)
rule.reading: every reading (Type I runs and the power controls): rate <= alpha + reading_k*sqrt(alpha(1-alpha)/R)
rule.tie_break: when both hold: leverage only with a clustered one-sided sign-flip gain over df at p <= contrast_alpha on at least one target pair and no such loss on any; otherwise df

consequence: sead_sexdiff re-issues both cell types' primaries with --residual-correction df, pinned to the release that contains it (0.13.0), in its own change; MOTCO documents df as validated at this configuration and keeps it opt-in

clustered_sensitivity.role: descriptive; never enters the verdict. The pooled tier with a replicate-clustered standard error, because a table's Type I readings share replicate seeds (decided 2026-10-30, before any paper-grade result)
